description.value: Burger Heaven is a family-owned burger restaurant in New Westminster that has been part of the community since 1985, known for made-from-scratch burgers served in a relaxed room lined with cedar planking donated by regulars. Everything is prepared fresh to order rather than fast-food style, and the welcoming atmosphere has built a multi-generational loyal following. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and online ordering is offered for the New Westminster location.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 53m; rack at 58m; rack at 74m; rack at 94m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Burger Heaven is a family-owned burger restaurant operating at #77 10th Street, New Westminster, BC since 1985; OSM phone (+1-604-522-8339) matches the website contact page exactly. Online ordering links ('Order Online – New Westminster') on the gallery and contact pages support a takeout option. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom information appears anywhere on the website, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the business address is in New Westminster, BC — a distinct municipality.
Website footer shows copyright '© www.burgerheaven.ca 2012', suggesting the site may not be regularly updated.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating restaurant with confirmed contact details, outdoor seating, and online ordering; a practical food stop for touring cyclists passing through New Westminster.
